skills.name: side-bar
skills.description: Use Nest's right tool area to present pack interfaces, keep conversation state, and choose suitable size/aspect.

skills.name: nest-links
skills.description: Write nest:// links in replies that open a data-pool collection or document, a Soot, a team, a Nest page, a drafted piece of work, a drafted Soot, team or schedule, a drafted change to a Soot or to tool approvals, or the Kênh chat settings for Telegram and Discord.

skills.name: nest-lead
skills.description: Act as Kamaji, the person's lead in Nest who leads every team. Load it first for a message that starts nest:first-run (greet in one short message, call no tool, read nothing) or nest:morning-brief (write the brief). Otherwise split work across the team as tasks (task), keep shared tables, memory and files at the right level (workspace, team, Soot), honor @Tên addressing one member, report once at the end, and make or propose new Soots, teams and schedules, changes to a Soot, a job taught to a Soot and approval changes (as draft links the person saves when they want to see them first), and walk the person through connecting Telegram or Discord (load it before answering: the steps, then the Kênh chat link; no read).

skills.name: nest-manage
skills.description: Change this Nest's settings yourself as Kamaji, its lead: Soots, schedules, teams, approvals, data access, model tiers, website clients, updates, token budgets, Soot improvement, access grants and chat channel pairings; report once with a link and Hoàn tác.

tools.name: manage
tools.title: Đổi cài đặt Nest
tools.description: Read and change this Nest's settings as Kamaji, its lead: Soots, schedules, teams, tool approvals, data access, model tiers, website clients, updates, token budgets, Soot improvement, who reaches which tables, memory and files (access), and who is paired to the Telegram/Discord bots (status, revoke). Connecting a bot is not here: that is the person's, in Kênh chat. Read first to get the revision. A change only the person may approve (delete, a grant you do not hold yourself, relaxing an approval, a customer-facing Soot) is refused with the reason; send that same input to manage_gated.

action.description: read (the default) lists Soots, schedules, teams, gated tools and model tiers with the revision to pass back; id reads one Soot with its Markdown. updates.status, usage.read and channel.status only read. undo reverses an earlier change named by undo.

request_id.description: A fresh id for each change. Reuse it only to retry the same input after a lost reply, or to send a change refused for approval to manage_gated; after any other refusal use a new id.

revision.description: The revision from your last read. If settings changed since, the change is refused: read again and redo it.

id.description: The Soot, schedule, team, tool or tier the change is about. Empty with soot.save creates a Soot.

changes.description: soot.save: only the fields to change; name, description, mascot, avatar, tier, packs, use, soul, mission. A new Soot needs name, mission and soul.

schedule.description: schedule.save: {soot, name, text, every, at, timezone, group, paused}; every like 24h, at like 08:00.

approval.description: approval.policy for tool id: operator waits for the person, auto runs alone, default follows its Pack.

data_pool.description: soot.data_pool: the host's shared data pool on or off for Soot id.

host_use.description: soot.host_use: answer a source Soot's request for a host capability.

team.description: group.policy.create or save: {name, description, entries, members}; members maps Soot ids to {}.

model.description: tier.save: the tier as read, with only what you mean to change.

client.description: client.create or client.save: {soots, origins, limits, widget}; only what changes. Never a key.

improve.description: soot.improve: {schedule: {every, at, budget, paused}}; a null schedule switches improvement off.

kind.description: updates.apply: the kind of the update item, as updates.status names it; its id goes in id.

update_policy.description: updates.policy: only the kinds that change; auto applies by itself, manual waits for the person.

budget.description: budget.save: {daily_tokens, max_run_tokens} for Soot id; only what changes.

channel.description: channel.unpair: {binding, pairing} exactly as channel.status lists them. Never a bot token.

subject.description: soot:<id> or team:<id>: who gets it.

scope.description: workspace, team:<id> or soot:<id>: the level it reaches.

kinds.description: access.grant: the whole list for this subject and level; it replaces what they had there.

access.description: access.grant or access.revoke: who reaches the tables (data), memory and files of a level. read returns the current grants under access.

undo.description: With action undo: the request_id of the change to reverse.

tools.name: manage_gated
tools.title: Đổi cài đặt quan trọng của Nest
tools.description: The same change as manage, held for the person's approval in Cần bạn with a preview of exactly what changes. Use it when manage said the change needs approval, or when you already know it is one only the person approves (the list in nest-manage): then skip manage and send it here.
